about: Labelled questions for precedent search over the synthetic baseline. Labels were written by hand from the fixture decisions, before measuring scores, and say what a reasonable reader would expect. They are demo checks, not a benchmark. Role defaults to pricing_director; as_of is fixed so recency is reproducible.
